title: Closeout summary: Auto-rebuild stale search index inside runSearch
body:
Subject: work:bw_work_e7a9fd7fcf73b38f
Status: verified
Priority: high

## Outcome

WHY: runSearch fails closed - loadFreshSearchIndex throws when the persisted index hash does not match the expected corpus hash (apps/cli/src/search-cli.ts lines 117-138). Integrity-wise that is correct, but from an executing agent mid-task the effect is search does not work, and an agent that hits the error will fall back to memory and re-derive scope, which is exactly when it invents. The index is invalidated by every mutation, so this fires constantly. WHAT: when the index is stale or missing, rebuild it inline via writeSearchIndex (already lock-guarded, search-cli.ts lines 49-57) and then serve the query; add a --no-rebuild flag preserving the current fail-closed behavior for callers that want it. The fresh default replaces any need for a separate --fresh escape hatch.

## Evidence

- bw_evidence_6900cc87e654f7f9: passed Implemented default stale search index auto-rebuild with --no-rebuild fail-closed escape hatch in checkpoint ffa6c80a; pnpm check and runtime tests passed.
